rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for congratulating someone on good news.

example.english: I congratulate you on getting a new job!
example.jyutping: gung1 hei2 nei5 lo2 dou2 fan6 san1 gung1

rows.note: Use this formal alternative in official or written congratulations rather than casual conversation.

example.english: We hereby congratulate your company on its official opening.
example.traditional: 我哋謹此祝賀貴公司正式開幕。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gan2 ci2 zuk1 ho6 gwai3 gung1 si1 zing3 sik1 hoi1 mok6
